chunks: What was narrated by ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn, from Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allāh, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥakam and Muḥammad ibn Ismāʿīl ibn Bazīʿ, from Hishām ibn Sālim, from Abī ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام, who said:
There is no objection to the man being placed forward and the woman placed behind, and to the man being placed behind and the woman placed forward—meaning in the salat (prayer) over the deceased.

key_terms.الرَّجُلُ: the male deceased in the funeral arrangement
key_terms.الْمَرْأَةُ: the female deceased in the funeral arrangement
key_terms.تُؤَخَّرَ: to be placed behind or delayed
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no objection; it indicates permissibility
key_terms.يُقَدَّمَ: to be placed forward or ahead

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to place the man before the woman or the woman before the man in salat (prayer) over the deceased?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the arrangement of male and female bier positions in salat (prayer) over the deceased when funerals are gathered together. It indicates permissibility in either ordering, showing flexibility in the performance of funeral prayer.
